CustomField.description: Reference to the signed Content Document generated from the guest upload workflow. Stored as Text(18) because Salesforce does not support custom Lookup fields targeting ContentDocument. Integrity enforced by Apex — do not write directly.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: ContentDocument ID of the signed output file. Salesforce platform does not allow a custom Lookup to ContentDocument, so this is stored as text. All writes go through SwiftSign Apex.
CustomField.label: Signed Content Document Id
